newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gujing Distillery 96 net rises 16.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gujing Distillery 96 net rises 16.7 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.74 yuan vs 0.95 yuan
Net assets per share 3.30 yuan vs 2.04 yuan
Company name: Anhui Gujing Distillery Co Ltd .

NOTE: The results are based on Chinese accounting standards except for net profits which are calculated under international standards. They were published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday.
Based on Chinese accounting standards, the company's 1996 net profits were 174.07 million yuan against 147.05 million in 1995, the report said.
Gujing's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.21 yuan per B share and 0.116 yuan per A share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 23, it said.
Trading in Gujing's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning for the annual result announcement and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
